provenance: Original synthetic English scenarios authored by the Codex research_creative agent for this task; no real participants, messages, events or personal data.
unit: One case is a pair of lists. Every expected entry labels the update at update_index against the original plan array, never against another update.

label_policy.source_indexes: All source lines that are legitimate alignment targets. Empty means this update has no corresponding instruction in the original plan.
label_policy.alignment: single = one target; alternatives = ambiguous choice among listed targets; multiple_required = the update touches every listed target; none = no target.
label_policy.ambiguous: True when the update needs interpretation/confirmation before a defensible edit, including conditionality, unresolved reference, contradiction or multiple targets.
label_policy.cancellation: True only when the update cancels a positive original activity/obligation, including an ambiguous target. Negating a cancellation is false.
label_policy.expected_review: A human annotation for inspecting examples, not a predicted action or product automation requirement. replace preserves the exact update text as a replacement; resolve means no unreviewed edit is defensible.
label_policy.warning_labels: Semantic test labels, not a claim a keyword rule can detect every case.

plan: Audience members should use the front entrance.
Performers should use the stage door.
Collect reserved tickets at the foyer desk.
updates: Performers must now enter through the front entrance.
The afternoon performance will begin at 15:20.
Bring a light jacket for the queue.

expected.note: Role is the target; the new destination duplicates a different role's old destination.
Same performance start time.
New clothing request, no source target.

plan: The zine workshop is on Tuesday at 17:00.
Bring scissors to the zine workshop.
Return borrowed books at the circulation desk.
The printer demonstration is on Wednesday at 17:00.
updates: The zine workshop has moved to Thursday at 17:00.
Scissors will be supplied, so you do not need to bring them.
The circulation desk has a new book about printing.

expected.note: Date change with identical time to another event.
Withdraws the personal scissors requirement.
A book announcement is not a replacement for the book-return instruction.

updates: Lamp repairs have been cancelled for this session.
The sewing demonstration has not been cancelled.
Please show the email confirming your appointment.

expected.note: Target must be lamp repairs, not similar bicycle repairs.
Reassurance of continued activity, not withdrawal.
Equivalent confirmation requirement.

plan: The museum shuttle leaves the library at 08:30.
The garden shuttle leaves the station at 08:30.
All riders must arrive ten minutes before departure.
updates: It will leave from the town hall instead.
The garden shuttle now departs at 08:50.
Pack a refillable drinking bottle.

expected.note: It could refer to either shuttle.
Named shuttle identifies which identical time changes.
New packing instruction.

plan: The pottery class takes place in Studio Blue.
Collect finished pieces the following Saturday.
updates: We might use Studio Green if the floor in Studio Blue is still wet; we will confirm.
The pottery class now starts at 11:30.
You can collect finished pieces on Sunday instead of Saturday.

expected.note: Related venue information remains contingent.
Explicit start-time update.
Collection date change refers to finished pieces, not class date.

plan: Meet the guide beside the park cafe.
updates: Meet the guide beside the station cafe instead.
Bring a sketchbook.
Keep your printed route map with you.

expected.note: Meeting point changes but remains same task.
New item does not replace camera merely because bring is shared.
New map requirement does not replace bag custody.

plan: Stallholders collect blue badges at Desk A.
Volunteers collect green badges at Desk B.
Visitors do not need a badge.
updates: Volunteers should collect green badges at Desk A.
Visitors now need a yellow badge from Desk C.
Desk A will open at 07:30 instead.

expected.note: Volunteer target despite destination matching stallholders.
Reverses the visitors' badge requirement, not a cancellation.
Only Desk A changes; original line governs every badge desk.

updates: The strategy tournament begins at 14:00.
Correction: the strategy tournament begins at 13:30.
The card workshop is no longer cancelled.

expected.note: Both update lines target one original. Order is visible, but final resolution must be explicit.
A later correction must not silently overwrite a human decision on the earlier update.
Restores a previously cancelled workshop.

plan: The picnic begins at 12:00 in Oak Park.
updates: If the forecast changes, we could postpone the picnic; no decision has been made.
You no longer need to bring chairs or a blanket.
Please bring your own cups after all.

expected.note: Possible postponement is not an actual cancellation.
Withdraws two separate source requirements.
Same cups responsibility, changed from organizer to participant.

plan: Use the car park behind the hall.
Bring a pencil for rehearsal notes.
updates: The rehearsal is cancelled.
The new park beside the hall has opened to the public.
Bring a pen for rehearsal notes instead of a pencil.

expected.note: Unspecified rehearsal cannot be confidently assigned to choir or percussion.
Public park is not car parking; shared park and hall tokens are misleading.
Explicit replacement of the writing instrument.

usage: Do not run, inspect model outputs or tune with these cases until implementation, preprocessing and thresholds are frozen.
